subject: Discovery recap — evaluation metrics, SDKs & short PoC checklist
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora@finlumen.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — evaluation metrics, SDKs & short PoC checklist

Hi Nora — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we have the same set of expectations going into a short PoC. Please flag anything I mis-stated.

Key pain points you shared
- Search relevance for legal + compliance docs is noisy (lots of false positives).
- Embedding pipeline is slow and expensive at peak, blocking daily syncs.
- Strict security: private VPC, customer-managed KMS, and audit logs required.

Current stack and constraints
- Backend: Node.js services (API layer) + Python batch jobs for ETL.
- Data store: Postgres + S3 (encrypted at rest).
- Infra: GCP project in a private VPC; limited ability for external egress during the PoC.

Success criteria (what would make a short PoC a win)
- Quality: embeddings improve NDCG@10 on your internal eval set by >= 10% (baseline provided).
- Latency: 95th percentile request latency <= 300ms for single-request rerank flows.
- Cost: tokenized inference cost at or below target you called out (we'll model this after initial runs).
- Security: ability to run under your VPC and KMS with audit-level logs visible to your SOC.

Proposed short PoC scope & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): sign mutual action plan and provide test account + minimal dataset. (Owner: Nora / FinLumen)
- Week 1: sandbox access + SDK samples; ingest 10k doc subset; end-to-end inference call from your Node service (owner: Marissa).
- Week 2: evaluate quality metrics and performance; tune batching/quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize (owner: Marissa).
- Week 3: security verification (KMS integration, VPC routing test) and run audit logs (owner: Vivek).
- Week 4: final review, pass/fail per success criteria and next-step commercial discussions.

SDK & API notes
- You indicated primary dev work is in Node, with Python ETL. We will provide both Node and Python SDK examples and a small SDK checklist for server-side integration (auth, retry, K/V cache).
- API compatibility: Redwood's hosted endpoints support streaming and structured output; we will provide a compatibility table for your existing reranker code path.

Immediate asks from our side
1) Send a 10k doc dump sample (s3 path or share link) for baseline metrics.
2) Confirm the list of required SOC2 artifacts (we can provide SOC2 report + pen test summary).
3) Agree to the proposed Week 1 sandbox window so we can prep creds and a temporary VPC peering plan.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, sample_sow.pdf, security_requirements.docx (stubs attached)

If this reads right, I'll ship the sandbox creds and a short SDK checklist by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

—
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
<aisha.rahman@redwood.ai> | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

From: Nora Patel <nora@finlumen.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinLumen Tech <tech@finlumen.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — evaluation metrics, SDKs & short PoC checklist

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear summary. That matches our internal notes; a few clarifications and a couple of asks from my side below.

Clarifications
- The 10k doc subset can be a CSV (id, text, metadata) in S3; we will share a presigned link first.
- Latency target: we want 95th percentile <= 250ms if at all possible for single-request rerank (our users are sensitive). If Redwood can get close to that in Week 2, we can sign off.

Security & infra
- Confirmed: we require customer-managed KMS and the ability to review audit logs for the PoC.
- We will need a short security questionnaire filled out (I attached the doc) — please have your security team complete the highlighted fields.

POC timeline
- We agree to the 4-week cadence, with the caveat that the security verification may shift the timing by a few days.
- Owner for dataset + S3 link: me (Nora).
Next steps
1) I will upload the 10k CSV by Monday EOD and send the presigned link.
2) Please send sandbox credentials + Node & Python SDK checklist.
3) Marissa and Vivek — can you please confirm if the private VPC peering flow you described will work from GCP in our environment?

Thanks — excited to see how this improves search relevance.

Best,
Nora
Director of Product, FinLumen
<nora@finlumen.com>

(attachment: security_requirements.docx)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap — evaluation metrics, SDKs & short PoC checklist

Forwarding FinLumen's reply — Nora will upload the 10k CSV Monday and attached their security doc. Immediate asks from me:
- Marissa: can you confirm feasibility on hitting 95th <= 250ms for a single-request rerank against a 10k subset? Also can you prepare Node + Python SDK snippets for our sandbox by Monday?
- Vivek: please review the KMS/VPC ask and confirm whether a temporary peering + private egress approach is acceptable for the PoC. If we need SSO or extra gating, flag that now.

I'll prepare the sandbox creds after we confirm the peering approach. I'm attaching the mutual action plan and sample SOW for reference.

Thanks — Aisha

Quick sync from my side:
- Feasibility: on the 10k subset we should comfortably get 95th <= 250ms with the right batching and instance class. I will validate exact instance sizing in our sandbox run.
- Deliverables by Monday: Node + Python SDK samples, a short performance checklist (how we measure latency/throughput), and a small README showing the end-to-end call from their Node service.
- Vivek: once you confirm the peering approach I'll schedule a 30-min joint tech kickoff with FinLumen for Tue 10am PT.
I'll own the Week 1 ingestion and Week 2 tuning steps.
